description: AnalyzeActivation publishes partial evidence by design (semantic.rs:179) to avoid deadlocking recursive cones; this tears down + re-publishes replacing facts (~4040 None->Some), each read as a change. Preserving omitted replacing publishers is UNSOUND (claims overwritten value). Investigate gating downstream-visible replacing publications on settled inputs WITHOUT deadlocking the recursive cone — e.g. settle-gate only the seal-visible replacing facts, or a two-phase publish. Grounded plan only.
title: Spike: deadlock-safe settled-gating of downstream-visible replacing-fact publication (kill partial-publication re-appearance churn)
